sentences.ar: بحارتنا، كان في جار فقير اسمه أبو علي.
sentences.en: In our neighborhood, there was a poor neighbor named Abu Ali.

sentences.ar: كان يشتغل نهار وليل عشان يطعم ولاده.
sentences.en: He worked day and night to feed his children.

sentences.en: Despite his poverty, he was always smiling and kind.

sentences.ar: مرة، مرض ولده وما كان معه مصاري للدوا.
sentences.en: Once, his child got sick and he had no money for medicine.

sentences.en: The child recovered, and Abu Ali never knew who helped him.
He asked the neighbors, but no one admitted it.

sentences.ar: من يومها، صار أبو علي يساعد كل محتاج.
